claim: Dealing with Harassment on AO3 : r/FanFiction - Reddit
summary: AO3 is a not-for-profit, relies on volunteers for moderation, and is probably swamped with bad behavior. So it may take some time for them to get to your earlier reports. That said, AO3 gives you the tools you need to curate your own space: you can put all comments on moderation, and delete any that you wish before they are ever posted.
